description: Stations d'épuration is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IDELUX. Liste des stations d'épuration actuellement en exploitation sur le territoire d'IDELUX. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Farming, Environment. Its keywords are eau, user, station, épuration. The portal shows 112 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
